title: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW
text: Gears of War: E-Day leads the charge on GeForce NOW this week, bringing Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago’s first fight against the Locust Horde to the cloud with GeForce RTX-powered performance.
